workflow: A data-reading operation exposes a temporary non-owning view of an internal buffer to a user-supplied callback.
The callback retains the view beyond the operation that provided it.
The data-reading operation returns and releases or reallocates the backing buffer while the retained view remains reachable.
A later read or write through the retained view accesses freed storage, causing a use-after-free failure instead of a safe invalid-view error.
summary: Retained temporary view outlives backing buffer
